Title: Tailor-made English course for staff at AKU
NewsSummary: English course for the Nutrition and Food Services Department
NewsContent:
The Network of English Enhancement (ELE_net) provides consultancy services for AKU clients who need more specific or tailor-made provision. A recent example of this service was a bespoke English language course delivered for the Nutrition and Food Department (NFSD). The 40-hour course was carefully designed by ELE_net in close consultation with the department, to ensure the classes would meet the specific language needs of the NFSD team.

The main objective of the course was to develop the learners' confidence and fluency in dealing with customers and interacting with colleagues. Each week, the eleven course participants attended four hours of face-to-face sessions which focused on functional language and role plays.

Senior manager, Mr Rahim Yaqub commented on the importance of English for NFSD staff. "The Nutrition and Food Services Department is one of the busiest places at AKUH with almost ten different eateries located within the campus serving about 10,000 consumers, including Faculty, Doctors, Students, Staff members and the general public on a daily basis. Our team members try to interact with each of our customers professionally with no room for mistakes." By the end of the course, the NFSD staff reported that they felt far more confident both when using English in their department, and while dealing with customers.

More information about the Consultancy Services and the bespoke English courses ELE_net offers can be found on our webpage or by sending us an email.
PullQuote: This course has increased the level of confidence of my staff. It has also added value to our services with our staff members now conversing in English when engaged with our consumers.
